reference: MAME 0.276 clone, Apollo DN3500, Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01
authorization: Prior explicit user instruction to send physical keyboard or mouse input when the guest display is black, to wake it.

test.precondition: A fresh native guest snapshot was black; MAME remained running and unpaused.
test.input: One-frame Shift pulse from existing I167 wake helper; released on the next frame.
test.result: The guest display woke and HP VUE/File Manager became visible.

additional_bounded_checks.result: released without error; visible File Manager state unchanged
released without error; visible File Manager state unchanged

conclusion: After disabling both mouse and the automatic mouse_device option, waking the guest display did not recapture the host pointer. X11 still reports the pointer over XChat, not the MAME window. This directly verifies the reported screen-wake trigger once. The deliberate-click recapture path and the historical XmpIcon selected/focus/hover/rubberband comparisons remain pending.
